candidates.source: Application syntax, type, missing source module or application exception demonstrated by diagnostics.
candidates.dependency: Dependency version, lockfile mismatch, resolution conflict or unavailable package; not a transport or DNS error.
candidates.packaging: Docker build context, COPY, entrypoint, listening port, bind address or health path configuration.
candidates.configuration: Invalid application specification, missing configured secret reference or permission configuration.
candidates.platform: Runner, builder, DNS, network transport, registry or platform service failure.
candidates.resource: Resource exhaustion supported by evidence such as OOMKilled or no space left; exit 137 alone is insufficient.
candidates.database: Database connectivity, authentication, schema or migration failure supported by database evidence.
candidates.unknown: Evidence is absent, contradictory or insufficient to distinguish a cause; none of the other categories is supported.

actions.source: 참조된 파일·행과 오류를 확인하고 소스를 수정한 뒤 다시 검사하세요.
actions.dependency: 의존성 선언과 lockfile을 확인하고 해당 패키지 관리자로 갱신한 뒤 다시 검사하세요.
actions.configuration: 필수 설정과 secret 참조를 확인하세요. 비밀값을 로그에 넣지 마세요.
actions.database: DB 연결과 migration 결과·부작용을 확인한 뒤 재실행 여부를 결정하세요.
actions.unknown: 원인을 확정할 근거가 부족합니다. 누락된 진단을 먼저 확인하세요.
